scope: UI estimate avoids long 94% plateau by moving estimated display up to 98%
provider telemetry log throttled for diagnostic usefulness
notes: Percent sync no longer calls _center_part_status on every tick.
Active row centering is debounced to once per active running/retrying part.
UI estimate now moves from 90 to 98 during provider overtime instead of freezing at 94; still reserves 100 for actual done event.
Provider telemetry is logged on stage/attempt change, 512KB audio buckets, or 30-second heartbeat, not every telemetry update.
